easyPrerequisites: You've gained life this turn if Oathsworn Vampire is in your graveyard.
description:
Cast Oathsworn Vampire either from your hand or graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Edgar triggers, creating a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
When the Vampire and Oathsworn Vampire enter, Elas il-Kor's first ability triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire.
When Oathsworn Vampire dies, Elas il-Kor's second ability triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat steps 4 through 6 using the Vampire token instead.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.
